# Pull Request Template

## Summary

Briefly describe the changes in this pull request.

## Related Issue

Fixes # (issue number)

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the contributing guidelines (CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have followed the coding standards (docs/development-standards.md)
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for the changed functionality
- [ ] I have run the quality checks (`pre-commit run --all-files`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation
- [ ] No datasets, model checkpoints, weights, or credentials are committed
- [ ] Public APIs and data schemas are not silently changed
